description: Three realistic policy fixtures. Tests validate structure and required policy markers only; no model inference, Devin session, database, or network call is performed.

cases.prompt: At the start of a feature session, ask for (a) a read-only inventory of the current authentication entry points and (b) a separate check of the official Devin docs for background-subagent permissions. The investigations are independent; keep the main session available to draft integration notes, and return evidence and file paths.

In the existing devin-demo repository, the ecosystem .sessions.json entry has the exact canonical cwd and session ID. Fix one isolated configuration typo, run the small existing unit-test suite, and stop. Do not create a new session, hosted repository, remote, commit, or push.
